theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_tma_continuous_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ τ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (ρ₁ C : ℝ), 0 < ρ₁ → 0 ≤ C → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → (∀ R : ℝ, τ (closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R) ≠ ∞) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z, g (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z, g z ∂τ))) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z, f z ∂τ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
